capabilities: Toggle saved filter switches on and off above a base
Add filter switches without writing YAML
Create quick property filters shown as chips
Pause and resume a group of switches
Generate one switch per value of a property (Pro)
extras: Freemium: the free version allows one group of up to 3 switches and one quick filter; Pro ($15 one-time or $5/month via GitHub Sponsors) removes limits and adds presets, default switches, and property-value switches. After updates the plugin opens a 'What's new' tab that promotes other NoteMods plugins and a Telegram chat; it can be turned off in settings. Requires Obsidian 1.13.4+ and the Bases core plugin; switch state is stored in the base file under a filterSwitches key; no telemetry and no network requests before GitHub sign-in.
intentEvidence: Bases Filter Switches puts a row of one-click switches under the toolbar of a base.
problem: Bases has no quick way to apply and remove saved filters on a view without editing filters by hand.

relations.evidence: needs Obsidian 1.13.4 or newer and the Bases core plugin

summary: Adds a row of one-click filter switches above Bases views and embedded bases to toggle saved filters on and off.
